paragraphs: Episode 1002
Episode 246. Battle for the Mithra Desert (12)
Upon conveying the message to Qwaul, he said the exact same thing as Jin.

{Damn it! How could a genius like me not think of that simple solution!? Leader, that'll work! It's possible to relay it through the passage, and it's also possible to activate the liberation mechanism from the inside!}
"Understood, Dr. Qwaul. I'll keep supplying the materials you need for the device. Please try to speed up the process if you can."
{Yes, yes! Now I feel motivated to work!}
"We probably have to make a lot of these liberation devices."
They threw the liberation device through the passage between Laprarosa and Earth.
Yet this simple solution was not without its challenges. The enemies wouldn't just stand by and watch. During combat, the device was at a high risk of damage due to artillery fire or shockwaves.
{Five days... no, um, three days? No, four days...? One every three days! If Valeria assists me throughout, I can make one every three days. That's the best we can do for now.}
"What are the conditions inside the passage? For instance, could the characteristics of the void inside destroy it? Could the pressure be too high, or anything like that?"

{Yes, didn’t the Leader brothers mention feeling a sudden contraction inside Laprarosa when there was a dimensional error? To explain in detail would be complicated... Simply put, it's entirely random. The internal pressure randomly rises and falls repeatedly.}
"But can the device withstand it?"

{If even a mighty species can't withstand it, how could such a delicate machine? Not likely. Adding an ancient box and a magical seal might help a bit, but it won't entirely negate the impact. The device will break. However, over time, that random pressure surge should naturally decrease.}
"I see what you mean."

{Yes, yes. Given that the pressure is randomly decreasing and increasing, it's best to start immediately, right? We can almost endlessly produce the devices, so we need to try as many times as possible. But I'm more concerned about something else, Leader.}
"What is it?"

{Currently, in Laprarosa, Battle God and Battle Kings are blocking the Red Plutonian’s attack coming through the passage. They must be spreading their energy widely to form a protective barrier. The device is more likely to get caught in that.}

"Ah, right...! Even before we came out, the Battle God had formed a massive energy barrier. As Jin knows, it's not just a simple barrier. It has the property to rip apart anything that approaches. Even if we manage to throw past the Red Plutonian’s  attacks, it might get caught in that and be destroyed."
Valeria said.
"Hmm... For that part, let's write a clear message on the box and throw it."
"Ah, such a simple solution."
"If we can't directly convey our intentions internally, this is the only way."
{That's fine. Chief, what shall we write on the box?}
"Just leave it to me. Carving it with my sword will be the most recognizable for the brothers."
{Ha, that's quite romantic.}
"Valeria will leave immediately. So, thank you, Dr. Kwaul."
Valeria was already packing up and leaving the conference room.
When the communication ended, Jin looked at his colleagues, patting his chest.
"The kids did well. I thought of this when I saw them playing outside."
"That might have been helped by Az Mill, kiddo."
"Right. Whatever it is, we need to reward the kids properly. Jett, tell Latree to close the snack shop for a while and only look after the kids."
"Yessir! The kids will love it, especially since they've always complained about not having enough snacks from Latree, haha."
Jin's gaze fell on the blueprint on the table. It was the blueprint of the Laprarosa liberation device that Valeria had just left behind.
'The size of the device itself seems to be about the upper half of Murakan. It weighs about 50 kilograms...'
Adding a shockproof steel box and various sealing magic to that, the volume and weight would about double.
For the superhumans with immense strength to carry or throw, it wasn't challenging at all. It seemed okay even to deliberately increase the weight and size for easy identification.
As Jett was about to go find Latree, the conference room communicator vibrated.
{Chief, it's Owl.}
"Mr. Owl, what happened in the desert?"

{...It's not a big deal. Just that demon named Masalrun is making a fuss about keeping your promise. He said if you don't keep the promise by today, there won't be any need to deal with the Red Plutonian.}
It was the promise to let him meet Shuri.
Now was the time to get along as best as possible with the three demons. Especially since Masalrun, right after he began taking action, drove away the aerial fortresses with his power alone.
"I understand, I'll go right now."
From afar, a loud noise echoed.
Even after the Bamel Alliance retreated, the Red Plutonian continued to battle in the desert. More precisely, they were firing continuously at Laprarosa's passage, avoiding the demons' interference.

The remnants and debris of chaos left in the center of the desert had already been swept away by that barrage. The sky, dyed entirely with Red Lightning, was filled only with red flashes as space warped and explosions spread.
Ban was likely guarding her siblings over there in Laprarosa.
"Oh dear, is the Battle God Brother okay?"
Belize said, noting the shadow that fell across Jin's face.
"I'm not feeling great, thinking there will be continuous bombardments like that, Brother Belize."

But in reality, Belize was also somewhat worried about Ban. The flying fortress, a weapon of war, undoubtedly exceeded her imagination in terms of power. The continuous bombardments reminded her of the battles the Plutonian’s race had against the Gods.
Jin, Belize, and Linpa.
The three of them visited the Desert this time. As the first liberation device had not been completed yet, they hoped to return this time without a fight if possible.
[So you've come to fulfill your promise with Masalrun, Jin Runkandel.]
As soon as Jin appeared in the center of the desert, Masalrun recognized him instantly. The three demon races seemed to use the surface of the desert as if it was their own sense.
Recalling his recent efforts to soothe Shuri, Jin remembered a phrase roughly translated by Ameris, something like 'I said I didn't like it, damn it!'.
However, it wasn't that he disliked being in contact with Masalrun because it caused problems, it was just uncomfortable.
"Masalrun, there's something I want to say before you touch Shuri."
[You keep playing with your cunning words as if to prove you're not an orphan.]
"Seems like everyone associated with the witch loves that word 'orphan'. I'm not being cunning, just saying that if Shuri reacts badly to your touch, it's not related to our agreement."
[Do you take Masalrun for a fool? Show me Shuri.]
[Kyahahaaaak....!]
As soon as Shuri emerged from the ruby, she showed her hostility towards Masalrun.
[Oh... Shuri, the witch Heluram completed a thread of sorrow by abandoning you.]
[Kyak!]
"Stop with the nonsense and just touch her quietly."
Curse of immortality.

Suddenly, Jin realized there were similarities between Shuri and the demons. The trio of demons and Shuri, none of them could be killed in a physical way. While it's not yet confirmed if the demon's immortality is as persistent as Shuri's...

'The curse on Shuri is probably of a much higher power. According to what Murakan and Quicantel once told me, at least a million human sacrifices are needed for that curse, and its effects on Shuri are much more horrifying...'
Unlike the demons, Shuri feels pain from physical blows. Even if her body is disintegrated down to particles, she just regenerates.
Up to now, no one has been able to kill Shuri. Binding or sealing her is possible, and even after such experiences, Shuri cannot die.
[Jin Runkandel, and Shuri... Ah, the precious gem of sorrow. You do not know the feelings the witch had when she cursed Shuri.]
"I don't care about that. Masalrun, you seem knowledgeable about curses. Do you know about the curse of immortality?"
Shuri struggled under Masalrun's touch. However, Masalrun handled Shuri with utmost care, like a delicate piece of pottery, showing no signs of harm.
[I know it well. Do you wish to lift the curse? Right now, it seems like Shuri is quite fond of you.]
I can't live forever like Shuri. Jin swallowed these words, waiting for Masalrun's next words.
[There are two ways to lift the witch's curse. However, both are nearly impossible.]
"What are they?"
[One is to become the lover of the witch. By doing so, you can make a single request to the witch. King Orgal overcame death using this method.]
Unexpected information, but it didn't seem any useful for now.
[The second is to erase the witch from this world. And that's something even your God couldn't do...]
"So, Solderet tried to kill the witch?"

[It's a bit different from killing, but similar. Yet, sometimes a mere mortal can achieve what a god cannot... Try your luck. Whether you fail or succeed, Masalrun will relish the process. No matter what the future holds, there will be profound sorrow.]
As Jin was choosing his words, Masalrun released Shuri.
[This is sufficient compensation for what Masalrun has done this time. If you wish for Masalrun's assistance in the future, ensure that you fulfill the contract as diligently as now...]
To this, Shuri was more surprised than Jin. She had thought it would take hours to be touched as a reward for defeating the enemies.
In her mind, Shuri thought, 'Is this all? Maybe I should let him touch me a bit more?' For Jin's sake, she felt she could endure that much.
[New visitors have arrived in the desert. Will you make a new contract with Masalrun?]
Upon hearing Masalrun's words, Jin heightened his senses and turned around. He felt a powerful individual approaching the center of the desert.
It was Elona Ziffle.
